_comment: People on the About page (<!--TEAM-->). photo is a slot in images.json. role "" shows a review marker (to be filled in); role null means no role line and no marker. duties are optional bullet points. Roles and duties: CCAR slide 'Team Member Roles & Responsibilities' (2026-11-18). Names as in HERON_WRITING/URSI/URSI_Summary_2page.tex.

people.name: Austin Hunter
duties: Oversee project execution and coordinate sub-teams
Develop core algorithms to retrieve surface-water boundaries and height variations, and perform reflected-signal tracking
Conduct scientific analysis, error quantification and cross-validation of results

people.name: Jack Abrams
duties: Pilot and co-pilot for flight testing and field operations; assist with FAA and CU Flight Ops approvals
Support Mission Planner and ground-station operations, flight planning, and waypoint generation for GNSS-R surveys
Develop and support GNSS-R data-processing and visualization tools

people.name: Frances Bailey
duties: Integrate the upgraded software-defined radios and GNSS antenna systems
Optimize the payload data flow for high-speed capture of baseband reflected signals
Manage payload-to-ground communication and in-flight telemetry

people.name: Nathan Cohen
duties: Lead assembly and integration of the UAV payload electronics and sensors
Manage lab operations and conduct rigorous bench testing before flights
Troubleshoot field hardware to maintain power, structure and payload reliability

people.name: Grace Halbleib
duties: Manage FAA and CU Flight Ops authorizations and regulatory compliance
Design the software architecture for remote-sensing data storage and organization
Develop automated pipelines to process raw UAV telemetry and payload data

people.name: Andras Szalay
duties: Develop algorithms to compute specular reflection locations using geoid models
Model and correct RF propagation errors and ionospheric delays
Extract GNSS signal parameters (amplitude, phase, pseudorange) from raw RF data
